name: ghostpaw-telegram
description: Telegram message mirror, search, sending, and moderation tools.
long_description: Read and search a local Telegram mirror, send messages, and moderate chats through the Telegram Bot API.

bot_token.title: Telegram token
bot_token.description: Bot API token for send and moderation execution.

db_path.title: Database path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite database.

tools.name: tg_read
tools.description: Read and query the Telegram database: messages, chats, users, reactions, and more.

tools.name: tg_send
tools.description: Outbound actions: send, edit, delete, pin/unpin messages, send typing indicator, and forward messages.

tools.name: tg_manage
tools.description: Moderation and chat administration: ban, unban, restrict, promote, kick users, and query member info.

tools.name: tg_connect
tools.description: Query bot connection status, configuration, and chat list.
